items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I played more with Frankie Deucing, with, uh, Edward Clemmen, them, with that Pelican band. I played a long time with them.

ctx.x: Did you play very often with Buddy Bowling?

No. He had his own line up. I never, I never played with him. I played more with Frankie Deucing, with, uh, Edward Clemmen, them, with that Pelican band. I played a long time with them. They kept, they, uh, they played, they used to go up in the country.
